text: Umbro is one of the brands of Iconix Brand Group, Inc., an American brand-management company that licenses its brands to retailers and manufacturers; Iconix acquired the Umbro brand from Nike for $225 million in 2012.
short: Umbro is an Iconix Brand Group brand; Iconix is owned by Avram Glazer's trust.
